caption: The drawing is monochromatic, created using pencil or graphite on a beige or off-white background. The central object is a large, lidded tankard or mug with a rounded body, a domed, finial-topped lid, and a large, ornate handle with a scroll at the bottom. The base of the tankard has horizontal ridges. The main illustration is set within a large rectangular frame. In each of the four corners outside the main frame, there is a smaller box containing technical side views, top views, cross-sections, and detailed measurements of various parts of the tankard. The top left box shows a circular object with a cross-section. The top right box features a square shape with a curved corner detail. The bottom left box depicts two views (side and top) of the tankard's handle, each labeled with numbers and dimension lines. The bottom right box presents a simplified outline of the tankard’s profile with labeled dimensions. The entire drawing has a precise, technical appearance, with clear lines, shading, and measurement annotations.
title: Pewter Mug
